pages.raw_title: About IRadimed | The MRI-Compatible Care Company — IRadimed
pages.raw_meta: We are the MRI Innovators - The leadership team at IRadimed has a deep history in developing and advancing MRI patient care and is proud to introduce the world’s first and only portable, MRI multi-parameter vital signs monitor that maintains the continuum of care throughout the patient’s entire MRI care cycle available for caregivers across acuities.
raw_blocks: “2026 not only signifies the 18th anniversary of our pioneering MRidium Infusion Pump, it also marks the 39th anniversary of my first MRI patient monitor as well as the introduction of the 3870, the next major milestone in MRI IV Infusion Pump history.”
- Roger Susi, Owner & CEO

At IRadimed (NASDAQ: IRMD), we work hard every day to provide you with the best possible products and services while pushing the boundaries of technical innovation. Since founding Invivo Research Inc, the predecessor to Invivo Corporation in the early 1980s and now founding IRadimed in 2004, I have lived through the MRI market’s transformation.

The 1990s and early 2000s were filled with MRI patient monitoring innovations such as wireless communication, anesthetic agent measurements, and temperature monitoring which helped fuel the rapid expansion of MRI applications. I am humbled to have witnessed how these devices of my design, have opened access to a wider range of patients as well as advanced MRI anesthesia procedures. I am proud to be a part of the technology that has made a positive difference in so many people’s lives.

During the past 18 years that I have been establishing the MRI infusion pump market, I have seen MRI patient monitors grow in size, complexity and cost. In my opinion these attributes are misaligned with the needs of modern healthcare. This observation has motivated our company to innovate again. We are excited to present you with the IRadimed 3880, the world's first and only non-magnetic, portable MRI patient monitoring system.

This is an exciting time for IRadimed as 2026 not only signifies the 18th anniversary of our pioneering MRidium infusion pump, it also marks the 39th anniversary of my first MRI patient monitor as well as the introduction of the 3870, the next major milestone in MRI IV Infusion Pump history.
We are the MRI Innovators.

IRadimed is a leader in MRI patient care with vast experience in MRI innovation. Roger Susi, our president and CEO, is the founder of Invivo Research where he pioneered the world’s first and best selling MRI patient vital signs monitoring brand, as well as founding IRadimed Corporation, the producer of the world’s first and best selling non-magnetic MRI infusion pumps and patient monitors.

The leadership team at IRadimed has a deep history in developing and advancing MRI patient care and is proud to introduce the world’s first and only portable, MRI multi-parameter vital signs monitor that maintains the continuum of care throughout the patient’s entire MRI care cycle. Below are a few of this team’s most notable contributions to MRI patient care.
1987 - FIRST MRI PATIENT MONITOR
The 3100 Omni-Trak was the world’s first MRI patient monitor to receive FDA clearance. The 3100 opened the doors for patients to receive an MRI that would have been previously turned away.
1996 - FIRST MRI WIRELESS USE
Roger Susi and his team pioneered the use of wireless technology in MRI with the 3150 Omni-Trak. The simple setup of the wireless display expanded the benefits of MRI monitoring to a global scale.
2005 - FIRST MRI IV INFUSION PUMP
The MRidium is the world’s first non-magnetic IV infusion system. This unique infusion pump allows the delivery of fluids at the MRI bore safely for IV sedations and critical care patients.
2016 - FIRST PORTABLE MRI MONITOR
The IRadimed 3880 is a non-magnetic patient monitoring solution, designed to move with the patient between their care unit and the MRI suite while safely maintaining the ‘continuity of care’.

raw_blocks: 3870 MRI IV Infusion Pump System
Introducing the 3870 Non-Magnetic MRI IV Infusion Pump System

This is the MRI Infusion Pump System that clinicians have been asking for. A cutting edge, easy-to-use infusion pump & wireless remote with all the workhorse and MRI safety DNA that makes MRI infusions easy! The non-magnetic design allows the 3870 MRI Infusion Pump to operate safely in ultra-high magnetic fields without the need for workarounds typically required with general hospital use infusion pumps.

Multi-colored LED lights in the pump door and door handle guide the clinician through the IV set loading process. Simultaneously, the lights correspond with user interactions, creating a simple and seamless user experience.

Straightforward animated graphics and input borders guide the user through each programming screen, making an easy-to-follow and user-friendly programming process for new or infrequent users of the MRI pump.

The docking spine makes the smart pump even smarter. When 1, 2, 3 or 4 pumps are docked onto a spine, they all act as one, sharing power and a remote control. Flexibility is maximized by detaching a pump, enabling intra-hospital transport.
A Complete MRI Medication Delivery Solution
From opening the door, priming & loading the IV set, to starting the infusion, IRadimed’s simplified and user-friendly GUI aims to reduce frustrations and errors during the MRI Infusion workflow.
The 3870 features a modern DERS drug library solution, allowing a single infusion pump to accommodate multiple patient care areas, with a comprehensive dose and concentration unit list.
The Wireless Remote eliminates delays caused by stopping the MRI scan to titrate or bolus by providing clinicians full operation from the MRI control room.
The docking spine makes the smart pump even smarter. When 1, 2, 3 or 4 pumps are docked onto a spine, they all act as one, sharing power and a remote control.
The intuitive design of the 3870 allows a single pump to infuse fluid sources from IV bags, bottles, 10mL to 60mL syringes, and 3rd party IV set adapting extension sets.
Customizable Drug Library That Goes The Distance

The 3870 features a modern Dose Error Reduction System (DERS) drug library solution, allowing a single infusion pump to accommodate multiple care areas, with a comprehensive dose and concentration unit list. These features allow a single pump to operate independently to deliver anesthetics, or to be combined with additional 3870 pumps to operate as a four-channel IV infusion pump system for critical care patients.

STEP 2 - Select Drug
STEP 3 - Select Dosing
STEP 4 - Program Infusion
Your Guiding Light to Easy MRI Infusions

IRadimed has simplified the IV set loading process with the new 3870. The new Graphical User Interface (GUI) will provide step-by-step instructions with appropriate symbols, guide lights, and audio feedback to aid the operator in day-to-day use. From opening the door, priming & loading the IV set, to starting the infusion, IRadimed’s simplified and user friendly GUI aims to reduce frustrations and errors during the setup of a new patient.
Infusing medications at the bore is the safest choice for your patients.
The non-magnetic design allows the 3870 MRI Infusion Pump to operate safely in ultra high magnetic fields without the need for workarounds typically required with general hospital use infusion pumps.

Learn more about infusing at the bore
Portable IV Infusion Pump Features

The 3870 helps replace 'work around' solutions like running long lines from conventional pumps through a sealed MRI door or wave guide. The 'work around' practice of placing long lines from outside the MRI control room may lead to inaccurate flow rates and alarm delays due to line occlusions, increased infection rates and costly medication waste.
Interactive on-screen guidance provides graphical animations combined with LEDs in the door and handle.
2. Best of Both Worlds Interface
A color touchscreen is combined with intuitive backlit physical buttons ensure users are able to care for the patient.
The graphical vial dynamically represents the infusion volume so users instinctively know how much fluid is remaining.
Each medication can support a Loading Dose, Primary Infusion, Bolus and 1 of 3 different KVO modes.
5. Free Flow Preventor Control
Door automatically keeps the flow preventor clamped during IV set loading eliminating the potential for nuisance alarms.
A single pump can accommodate multiple care areas and 60 Unique Dosing Units to ensure infusion accuracy.
7. Alarms That Guide The user
Infusion downtime is reduced with color coded alarms with instructions on how to correct the alarm conditions.
8 Wireless channels allow for each 3870 to infuse and be wirelessly controlled by 3875 Remotes simultaneously.
9. Industries Highest Gauss Rating
15,000 Gauss MRI Infusion Accuracy and 30,000 Gauss Projectile Protection protect your patients and your equipment.
10. Multiple Different Fluid Sources
3870 has IV Sets to allow infusion control of 3 rd party IV sets as well as Bag, Bottle and Syringe Fluid Sources.
Only 6 lbs with battery and greater than 8 Hours of Continuous infusions on Battery ensure your patient can get to and from MRI.
Retractable stand is tucked away underneath the pump to allow bedside and tableside operation when an IV pole is not needed.
13. 360 Degree Visible Dome Light
Smart Dome Light provides an additional visual indication of the infusion status and any alarm conditions.
“Finally, an efficient way to transport out critical patients to the MRI.”
Modern Problems Require Modern Solutions

The days of transferring a patient from traditional transport equipment to the MRI monitor & MRI IV pump in the hallway outside of the MRI suite is now a thing of the past. IRadimed non-magnetic devices are small, lightweight, easy to use and designed to travel with the patient between the MRI suite and their care unit. These unique transport attributes increase MRI efficiency while decreasing the amount of time critically ill patients are away from their care unit.

Transferring the patient to an MRI monitor and IV infusion pump in the originating department such as an Intensive Care Unit, Emergency Department or Anesthesia induction room reduces the need for unnecessary equipment transfers providing the following benefits:
Reduction in Time Critical Patients are ‘Off Unit’
‘Continuity of Care’ During Inter-Departmental Transports
Efficient Use of the MRI Scanner and Increased Patient Throughput

NOT AVAILABLE IN ALL MARKETS
